fr_html: Le PRESIDENT répond affirmativement. Il proposera l'article 5 de son projet comme amendement à l'article 2 du projet Root—Phillimore.
en_html: The PRESIDENT replied in the affirmative. He would put forward article 5 of his project as an amendment to article 2 of the Root—Phillimore plan.
